company_description: Ferrovial is a Spanish infrastructure services group operating toll highways, airports, and construction services in Europe and North America.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total group revenue from infrastructure and construction activities.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation, reflecting the group's operational profitability.

kpis.name: Consolidated Net Income
kpis.explanation: Group's net profit, boosted by disposals of long-term assets in 2024.

kpis.name: Liquidity Position
kpis.explanation: Available cash including proceeds from asset disposals and dividends received from infrastructure assets.

kpis.name: Consolidated Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Negative net debt position (cash surplus) excluding infrastructure projects.

kpis.name: Dividends Received from Infrastructure Assets
kpis.explanation: Cash flows generated by managed infrastructure assets, record level in 2024.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditure
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in 2024, primarily in highways and airports.

kpis.name: Market Value of the Group
kpis.explanation: Market capitalization at end-2024 reflecting a 23% increase in share price.

kpis.name: Nasdaq Listing
kpis.description: In May 2024, Ferrovial was listed on Nasdaq, marking a major step in its internationalization and strengthening its presence in the United States, 25 years after its IPO in Madrid.

kpis.name: Toll Highway Growth
kpis.description: All managed highways recorded strong revenue per transaction growth, significantly outpacing inflation.

kpis.name: Improvement in Construction EBIT Margin
kpis.description: The construction division exceeded its EBIT margin target for the year, demonstrating improved operational efficiency.

kpis.name: New Terminal One at JFK Airport
kpis.description: The flagship New Terminal One project in New York remains on schedule and within budget, with commissioning planned for 2026.

kpis.name: Stake Acquisition in IRB Infrastructure Trust
kpis.description: Acquisition of a 24% stake in IRB Infrastructure Trust for 710 million euros, strengthening the highway portfolio.

kpis.name: Shareholder Distributions
kpis.description: Total distributions of 895 million euros including cash dividends and share buybacks, reflecting confidence in cash generation.

kpis.name: Recognized ESG Leadership
kpis.description: Ferrovial ranked first in Europe and second globally in the Construction & Engineering sector according to the Dow Jones Best in Class Index.

risks.description: Major infrastructure projects such as Terminal One at JFK carry risks of cost overruns and delays. The complexity of managing multiple assets across Europe and North America exposes the group to execution risks.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the report (Terminal One mentioned as highlight), measured language but explicit recognition of budget and timeline challenges, stable trend, significant weight for future growth.

risks.description: Dependence on toll revenue from managed highways exposes Ferrovial to fluctuations in road traffic and economic cycles. Variations in transaction volumes directly impact profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as growth driver (revenue per transaction), neutral language, inherent risk to business model, moderate weight due to geographic and segment diversification.

risks.description: Infrastructure activities are subject to strict regulations regarding pricing, environment, and safety. Regulatory changes in the United States and Europe could affect margins and investments.
risks.score_rationale: Implied in ESG commitments and compliance (Directive 2014/95/EU, Taxonomy Regulation), standard compliance language, trend toward stricter regulation, moderate weight.

risks.description: Inflation and high interest rates impact construction costs and project financing. While toll revenues outpaced inflation in 2024, an economic recession could reduce traffic and volumes.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned implicitly (growth outpacing inflation), positive language but recognition of macro context, trend of economic uncertainty, moderate weight for profitability.

risks.description: Ferrovial has committed to ambitious decarbonization targets (carbon neutrality by 2050, aligned with Paris 1.5°C). Failure to meet these goals could affect ESG ratings and access to sustainable financing.
risks.score_rationale: Voluntary and proactive commitment (targets strengthened in 2024), positive and ambitious language, favorable trend (Dow Jones recognition), low weight as competitive advantage rather than immediate risk.
